title.en: DeepSeek Releases V4-Flash-Vision-Exp Experimental Multimodal API
title.zhHans: DeepSeek 发布实验性多模态 API 模型 V4-Flash-Vision-Exp

searchSummary.en: DeepSeek made the experimental V4-Flash-Vision-Exp model available through its API on August 21, 2026, adding image input and Files API support to the V4-Flash line.
searchSummary.zhHans: DeepSeek 于 2026 年 8 月 21 日通过 API 提供实验性 V4-Flash-Vision-Exp，为 V4-Flash 系列增加图像输入与 Files API 支持。

summary.en: DeepSeek's official API updates log records the August 21, 2026 availability of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp. The experimental model accepts mixed text-and-image input and supports reusing uploaded files across requests. DeepSeek reported benchmark gains, while the retained independent review did not reproduce the vendor benchmark suite.
summary.zhHans: DeepSeek 的官方 API 更新日志记录了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 于 2026 年 8 月 21 日可用。该实验性模型接受图文混合输入，并支持在请求间复用已上传文件。DeepSeek 公布了基准提升数据，但保留的独立评测并未复现其完整基准套件。

narrative.en: A captured release page carries an August 28 metadata timestamp, while DeepSeek's separately captured official updates log explicitly dates API availability to August 21. EpochArc uses the dated updates log as the event-date source and records the page-metadata discrepancy in the source notes. Writingmate's hands-on review confirmed the model's availability and identified limitations in ambiguous chart reading and degraded scans; its observations are not a formal benchmark replication.
narrative.zhHans: 抓取到的发布页带有 8 月 28 日的元数据时间戳，而另行保留的 DeepSeek 官方更新日志明确将 API 可用日期标为 8 月 21 日。EpochArc 以该带日期的更新日志作为事件日期依据，并在来源说明中保留页面元数据差异。Writingmate 的上手评测确认了模型可用性，也指出其在模糊图表和受损扫描件上的局限；该评测并非正式的基准复现。

description.en: Makes experimental image input available in DeepSeek's low-latency API line for multimodal agent workflows.
description.zhHans: 使 DeepSeek 的低延迟 API 产品线可在实验状态下处理图像输入，用于多模态智能体工作流。

description.en: Adds a Files API workflow that can reduce repeated image uploads for API users, subject to experimental-model limitations.
description.zhHans: 增加可减少重复图像上传的 Files API 工作流，但仍受实验性模型的使用边界限制。

text.en: DeepSeek's official updates log records that V4-Flash-Vision-Exp became available on its API on August 21, 2026, with mixed text-and-image input and Files API support.
text.zhHans: DeepSeek 官方更新日志记录，V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 于 2026 年 8 月 21 日在其 API 上可用，支持图文混合输入与 Files API。

text.en: DeepSeek reported multimodal-agent benchmark improvements while keeping the model in its experimental release track.
text.zhHans: DeepSeek 报告了多模态智能体基准提升，同时仍将该模型列为实验性发布。

text.en: The model is experimental, and retained independent hands-on coverage did not reproduce DeepSeek's benchmark comparisons with frontier proprietary models.
text.zhHans: 该模型处于实验阶段，保留的独立上手评测并未复现 DeepSeek 与前沿专有模型的基准对比。

editorial.reviewNotes: Reviewed against the official dated updates log and a retained independent hands-on review; vendor benchmark claims remain bounded.

changeLog.summary: Added V4-Flash-Vision-Exp experimental multimodal API release.
Completed pre-publication factual-boundary, provenance, and evidence-grade review.
